name: Avoid Interfaces with a low comment/code ratio (ABAP)
description:
ABAP interfaces should be documented. This reports shows all the ABAP interfaces with less than a defined comment / code ratio. This ratio is a parameter of the rule and can be changed at will.
Only local interfaces are taken into account (interfaces not defined in interfacepools).
output:
Associated to each violation, the following information is provided:
- The number of violation occurrences
- Bookmarks for violation occurrences found in the source code
rationale: Maintainability of the code is facilitated if there is documentation in the code. This rule will ensure there are comments within the Artifact.
alternativeName: Avoid Interfaces with a low comment/code ratio (ABAP)
